summary.en: One step the assistant took on the way to its answer (searched the notes, read a file, checked the calendar), shown as a quiet one-line `<details>` that opens to what it found. The answer stays the main thing.
summary.id: Satu langkah yang diambil asisten untuk sampai pada jawabannya (mencari di catatan, membaca berkas, memeriksa kalender), ditampilkan sebagai `<details>` satu baris yang tenang dan bisa dibuka untuk melihat temuannya. Jawaban tetap yang utama.

en.title: What the assistant looked up
en.desc: Closed by default. Open one to check the sources the answer used.

descriptionRead Problem set 3expand_more
Question 4: a 7 kg box pushed with 20 N against 6 N of friction.
The net force is 14 N, so the box accelerates at 2 m/s². Your answer used 20 N, the push alone.
